factualRecord.return: Pause while inhaling, then exhale to lower to the mat.

factualRecord.variant: Supine articulated pelvic curl with arms pressing the mat
factualRecord.start: Lie supine with knees bent, knees and heels about sit-bone width apart, and long arms pressing the mat beside the hips.
factualRecord.initiation: Pause on an inhale, then exhale to tuck the pelvis with abdominal effort before glute engagement.
factualRecord.move: Engage glutes and articulate the hips upward toward a line between knees and shoulder blades.
factualRecord.middle: Pause while inhaling, with support through the center, arms and legs.
factualRecord.return: Exhale, lower the sternum and articulate the spine toward the mat.
contacts: Lower back touches the mat during the tuck.
The source names support through arms and legs; exact foot patches are unspecified.
